author: Praxis I
title: Dual BRBG + Global MNN Translation (alpha=0.5, k=20)
abstract: Apply a lightweight global MNN translation on the whitened ComBat-PCA64 + PBVE embedding: MNN pairs between each batch and the largest reference batch yield a robust median translation vector; apply a small step (alpha=0.5). Graph path unchanged (adaptive residualized PCs + equal-quota balanced kNN, k=48).
